description: This file defines the 'File' class within the Goteo library, responsible for creating file handler objects, either for local file storage or Amazon S3 cloud storage, based on configuration and parameters.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A factory class providing static method to instantiate appropriate file handler objects based on configuration and input parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation, indicating usage of static methods only.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates and returns a file handler object, either for S3 or local filesystem, based on configuration constants and provided options.
